content.title: Bill Murray celebrated with UConn band after stunning win vs. Duke
content.text: Bill Murray celebrated with UConn band after stunning win vs. DukeUConn is heading back to the Final Four, and they did it dramatic fashion. The Huskies trailed the No. 1 overall seed Duke by as many as 19 points, but climbed back to make it a 72-70 game with 10 seconds to play. After a bad pass turnover by Cayden Boozer, UConn's Braylon Mullins canned a 35-foot three-pointer to give the Huskies the improbable 1-point lead with 0.3 seconds left on the clock.It was pure chaos in Washington, DC, with Duke fans coming to grips what just happened and UConn fans celebrating. One of those Husky fans was actor Bill Murray, who has been in attendance for all four of the team's 2026 NCAA tournament games so far. Murray's son, Luke, is an assistant coach on Danny Hurley's staff, helping run the Huskies offense.AdvertisementAfter the game, the Groundhog Day actor was seen high-fiving the UConn band in celebration.1 / 9Braylon Mullins all-time shot for UConn in 9 stunning photosMar 29, 2026; Washington, DC, USA; UConn Huskies guard Braylon Mullins (24) hits a go-ahead three-point basket late in the second half during an Elite Eight game of the East Regional of the men's 2026 NCAA Tournament at Capital One Arena. 2 / 9Braylon Mullins all-time shot for UConn in 9 stunning photosMar 29, 2026; Washington, DC, USA; UConn Huskies guard Braylon Mullins (24) hits a go-ahead three-point basket late in the second half during an Elite Eight game of the East Regional of the men's 2026 NCAA Tournament at Capital One Arena. 9 / 9Braylon Mullins all-time shot for UConn in 9 stunning photosMar 29, 2026; Washington, DC, USA; UConn Huskies guard Malachi Smith (0) celebrates with UConn Huskies guard Braylon Mullins (24) after a game-winning three-point basket against the Duke Blue Devils in the second half during an Elite Eight game of the East Regional of the men's 2026 NCAA Tournament at Capital One Arena. Next up, UConn and Murray will head to Indianapolis for the Final Four.This article originally appeared on For The Win: Bill Murray celebrates with UConn band after Elite Eight win vs. Duke
